description:
KingsPlaybook's publicly-posted picks for a date — game-market and player-prop — each with its result and closing-line context. Use this to backtest against the actual posted record. Requires a Premium plan.

Args: date ('YYYY-MM-DD'); optional type ('game' | 'prop', omit for both); optional sport (e.g. 'nba').
Returns JSON: { data: { game_picks: [...], prop_picks: [...] }, meta: { count, game_pick_count, prop_pick_count, date, ... } }.

sport.description: Optional sport filter, e.g. nba, mlb, nhl

type.description: Filter to game-market or player-prop picks; omit for both

name: kingsplaybook_get_pick_history
title: Get pick performance history
